title: Spy runs off the balcony under the high end of zip line GE 13, jumps, catches it and rides it down

spawn.spot: balcony z -166.67 under the high end of ZL GE 13, 40 uu down the line from it, facing down the line
spawn.notes: ZL GE 13 from (-2324.0, 1472.3, 130.7) down to (-1822.1, -319.4, -183.8): 1860.7 uu long, slope 0.169, line 297.4 above the balcony at the high end. The balcony runs 16 to 128 uu down the line from the high end (a wall behind it); beyond is a 1040 uu drop to the yard. Running jump at about 100 uu: CheckZipArms catches the line once Velocity.Z < 254 (about 0.24 s after the take-off), within 60 uu of the hang point 116 under the line. The low end is over a walkway at z -488. Found with re/tools/difftest/gespots.py (zl).

inputs.note: running jump at about 100 uu, stick released
